To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the tetrazolotetrazine and tetrazolo[5, 1-c]pyrazine derivatives with an ethoxycarbamate group in the 5 position are the most active inhibitors of carboxesterase.
the synthesized compounds are selective and reversible inhibitors of CaE and have good antiradial activity.
a series of 4,7-dialkyl-7-polyalkoxy-7-polyfluroalkyl-7H-4,7- dihydroazolo [5,1-c] [1,2, 4] triazines were synthesized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new class of polyfluoro-substituted dihydroazolo- and pyrazolotrirazine compounds with potential for use in the development of new drugs for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
the synthesis of polyfluoroazolotriazines as selective and effective inhibitors of CaE and antioxidants.
the synthesis, molecular docking, biological activity, and structure-activity relationship (SAR) of polyfluoroazolotriazines as selective carboxyl-esterase inhibitors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tetrazole-containing compounds are the best inhibitors of CaE and are also promising antioxidants.

the presence of an ethoxycarbonly group, elongation of the polyfluroalkyl substituent, and the presence of a tetrazole or a 7-pheny group in position 7 are the key factors for effective and selective inhibition of CaE and antiradical properties of the studied compounds.

the presence of a tetrazole moiety in 7-polyfluorinated dihydroazolo-[5,1-c] [1,2, 4]triazine scaffold is crucial for the development of effective and selective CaEs inhibitors with additional antioxidant activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesized polyfluoroalkyldihydroazolotriazines have the potential to be developed as selective CaE inhibitors with antiradical properties.
the obtained results provide a basis for the design of a new generation of CaE-selective inhibitors with potential applications as anticancer drugs.

the synthesized polyfluoroalkyldihydroazolotriazines can be used as potential multifunctional agents for the prevention and treatment of diseases associated with oxidative stress and cholinergic dysfunction.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the introduction of the polyfluorinated substituent and the ester group into the dihydroazolo-5,1-c[1,2, 4]triazine ring leads to compounds with a high inhibitory effect toward CaE and good antioxidant activity.
polyfluorinated 4,7-diazolotriazines with a tetrazolotetrazine core are promising selective CaE inhibitors.

7-hydroxypyrazolotriazine and 7-hydroxtetrazolotriazinone derivatives with a tetrazolyl or phenyl substituent at the 4-position and a polyfluoroalkoxy substituent at the N-1 position are promising selective inhibitors of CaE.
